figure.purpose: Every amount, total, and the salary input — tabular, ledger-column alignment.

label.purpose: Section headers, field labels, category tabs, masthead month line.

shadows.name: ledger-lift
shadows.purpose: The single authored shadow in the system — the right-hand ledger card, read as paper lifted off the desk. Never reused elsewhere.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.value: stampIn 0.16s ease-out (scale 0.3→1, opacity 0→1, on the checkbox's check glyph)
motion.purpose: The one signature motion moment: marking an expense paid reads as a ledger entry being stamped settled.

motion.name: row-fade-in
motion.purpose: New expense rows entering the ledger.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ajouter / Connecter — postal-ink fill, icon + label.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M8 2v12M2 8h12"/></svg>Ajouter</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: #1C3F6E; border: none; border-radius: 3px; padding: 9px 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #142C4E; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C3F6E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Importer/Exporter CSV, actions de synchro — inverse au survol.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #566070; background: #EDF0F5; border: 1px solid #CCD4DE; border-radius: 3px; padding: 5px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1C3F6E; color: #fff; border-color: #1C3F6E; }

components.name: Category Tab
components.description: Étiquette de catégorie sur la règle de la page de grand livre.
components.css: .ds-cat-label { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 2px solid #1C3F6E; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-cat-tab { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #fff; background: #1C3F6E; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; line-height: 1; } .ds-cat-total { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #20242B; padding-bottom: 7px; }

components.name: Stamped Checkbox
components.description: Case à cocher 'payé' restylée en tampon d'encre vert.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { appearance: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1.5px solid #CCD4DE; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-checkbox:hover { border-color: #1D5B3A; } .ds-checkbox:checked { background: #1D5B3A; border-color: #1D5B3A; } .ds-checkbox:checked::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4.5px; top: 1.5px; width: 4px; height: 8px; border: solid #fff; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1C3F6E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Dot
components.description: Tag couleur libre (vert/rouge/aucun) — cercle, volontairement distinct de la case à cocher carrée.
components.css: .ds-tag-dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid #CCD4DE; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; transition: transform 0.1s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-tag-dot:hover { transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-tag-dot.ds-tag-green { background: #1D5B3A; border-color: #1D5B3A; } .ds-tag-dot.ds-tag-red { background: #A8352A; border-color: #A8352A; }

components.name: Ledger Text Input
components.description: Champ texte/nombre sans boîte — une seule règle en bas, qui se colore au focus.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #20242B; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #CCD4DE; border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 2px; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #66707F; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1C3F6E; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Panneau de formulaire ou page de grand livre — bordé, plat, un seul coin légèrement arrondi.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #CCD4DE; border-radius: 3px; padding: 16px 18px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #66707F; margin-bottom: 10px; }

narrative.overview: This is the French household ledger-and-wall-register the budgeting ritual already runs on, rebuilt as a screen — not another neutral SaaS dashboard wearing a single accent color as personality. Every month the page opens on its own register line ("Cahier de Novembre 2026"), and the body reads like an account book: a committed postal-ink blue owns the shell and the category tabs, figures run in a tabular monospace like a real ledger's number column, and red is spent on exactly one thing — what is still owed. The system refuses two defaults at once: the "grey cards, one thin accent" dashboard rut (what this app's own first version was), and the warm-cream-serif rut most AI-generated interfaces reach for when given a free hand.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-on-paper palette: postal-ink blue as the only structural color, ledger red and stamp green reserved strictly for meaning (due / settled), never decoration.
Two type voices with a functional split: Inter carries every word, IBM Plex Mono carries every number.
Flat, ruled surfaces — no card-grid cliché, no rounded pill shapes, no soft decorative shadows except the one real paper-lift under the ledger itself.
Desktop-led, mobile-honest: the same ruled-ledger language collapses to a single stacked column on narrow viewports without losing any figure.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red appears on at most one live figure at a time — the amount still owed. A page with two red numbers has stopped meaning anything.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Postal ink blue is the system's only decorative color. Everything else is either structural neutral or strictly meaning-bearing. A third decorative color is a system violation, not a variant.

rules.name: The Ledger-Column Rule
rules.body: Any value that is a sum of money is set in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums, full stop — never the body font, never proportional figures.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Exactly one region of the page gets a shadow: the ledger itself. A shadow anywhere else is decoration creeping back in.

dos: Do keep red to exactly one live meaning: money still owed. Never use it for error states — those get slate/graphite, not red.
Do set every currency figure in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals, never the body font.
Do keep every icon as an authored inline SVG in one consistent stroke — never a unicode glyph or emoji standing in for one.
Do theme focus rings, selection color, and the checkbox's check mark from the postal-ink/stamp-green palette — never leave a browser default un-themed.
donts: Don't introduce a third decorative color beyond postal-ink.
Don't add a shadow anywhere but the right-hand ledger card.
Don't reach for a boxed/bordered input style for text or number fields — the bottom-rule treatment is the system's signature.
